title: dracocephalum incanum
intro: Dracocephalum incanum, commonly known as the Wolf's Mint or Blue Dragon, is a perennial plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of D. incanum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenoid lactones. The bioactive constituents of D. incanum have been found to exhibit antioxidant, hepatoprotective, and anti-cancer activities, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
